stories.headline: Block Pursues National Trust Bank Charter to Custody Bitcoin and Stablecoins
stories.body: Block aims to establish a national trust bank that would provide custody and related fiduciary services, including those for bitcoin and stablecoins, the company said in a Tuesday (Sept. 8) press release. stories.headline: Chime to buy longtime partner Stride Bank for $590 million
stories.body: Owning a bank will allow Chime to build products faster, shed partner banking fees, and reduce its funding cost, while also allowing the neobank to more efficiently expand its lending business.
